statements.subject: server
statements.description: This header MUST be included in the SETUP response, PLAY and PAUSE responses for media that are time-progressing, PLAY and PAUSE responses after any change for media that are Dynamic, and in PLAY_NOTIFY requests that are sent due to Media-Property-Update.
statements.pre_cond: (media.property = time-progressing | media.property = Dynamic) & (trigger = SETUP_response | trigger = PLAY_response | trigger = PAUSE_response | trigger = PLAY_NOTIFY_Media-Property-Update)
actions: include Media-Range header in SETUP response
include Media-Range header in PLAY response for time-progressing or Dynamic media
include Media-Range header in PAUSE response for time-progressing or Dynamic media
include Media-Range header in PLAY_NOTIFY request for Media-Property-Update

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A Media-Range header without any range specifications MAY be included in GET_PARAMETER requests to the server to request the current range.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In this case, the server MUST include the current range at the time of sending the response.
actions: include current media range in GET_PARAMETER response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The header MUST include range specifications for all time formats supported for the media, as indicated in Accept-Ranges header (Section 18.5) when setting up the media.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MAY include more than one range specification of any given time format to indicate media that has non-continuous range.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The range specifications SHALL be ordered with the range with the lowest value or earliest start time first, followed by ranges with increasingly higher values or later start time.

statements.subject: rtsp
statements.description: However, it shall be assumed that media time progresses in direct relationship to wallclock time (with the exception of clock skew) so that a reasonably accurate estimation of the media range can be calculated.
